description: 50V 82nF X7R ±10% 0603 Multilayer Ceramic Capacitors MLCC - SMD/SMT ROHS
compatibility_notes: Second code on the existing generic 0603 82 nF capacitor: the plain generic ID keeps its reviewed preference C1708 (FH 0603F823M500NT, Y5V +/-20% 50 V). C1951 is the exact FH X7R +/-10% SKU (0603B823K500NT, 50 V) from the same maker, so it gets its own maker/mpn variant ID linked via generic_oomp_id, following the established variant taxonomy. Rating comparison from the staged capture: same 82 nF value, package and 50 V rating, but X7R +/-10% is the more stable, tighter-tolerance dielectric than the Y5V +/-20% preference; projects requiring X7R stability at 82 nF/0603 should pick this variant explicitly and the Y5V preference is not downgraded. Two-terminal MLCC (pin_count 2); stock 29 at capture recorded as observed (low; does not change identity). Edits made under the capacitor family lock.
